meaning:
Λιβερῖτνος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. libertinus),
a freedman: ἡ συναγωγὴ ἡ λεγομένη Λιβερτίνων Act.6:9 (Bl. thinks the original reading was Λιβυστίνων, Phil. Gosp., 69 f.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose…
